description: Passes or blocks four gate signals independently, 6HP, timing each change so that a pulse already under way is not cut short

params.text: Toggles that channel between passing its gate and blocking it; pressed while that gate is low the change is immediate, pressed while it is high it is held until the next pulse begins

inputs.text: The gate signal for that channel

outputs.text: Carries that channel's gate input while the channel is enabled, and 0V while it is disabled

menu: Fast toggle when gate input is low — on by default, is what makes a press act immediately while that channel's gate is low; turned off, every press is held until the next pulse begins

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
